hooks.command: filepath=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path') && case "$filepath" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.md) npx prettier --write "$filepath" ;; esac

cmd=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command") && if printf "%s" "$cmd" | grep -Eq -- "grep.*[[:space:]]--include=\*"; then echo "zsh: an unquoted grep --include glob fails with no matches found. Quote the glob (--include='*.ts') or use the Grep tool." >&2; exit 2; fi
